messages:
alex: quick off-hours check-in — i'm pushing the quantization change to canary tonight. deploy window 01:00-02:00 UTC. i'll be oncall for the rollout. @maya @sam please ping if perf looks off. :rocket:
maya: seeing ~20% token-cost improvement locally on gpt-small-quant. PR merged, CI green.
sam: nice. i'll add a latency smoke test to the pipeline. can we fail fast if p95 > 250ms?
alex: yes, add that. put the threshold in eng/sre/runbooks. auto-rollback is OK if it trips.
kevin: heads-up — i'll be OOO 00:30-01:30 UTC but monitoring is on autopilot. route alerts to @oncall and cc me if it's noisy.
ops-bot: scheduled maintenance reminder: infra bastion reboot at 01:00 UTC. expect short SSH interruptions.
maya: blocker: one integration test flakes on the batcher when seq_len > 2k. testing a temporary reduce of max_batch_size to avoid OOMs.
sam: can you open a short ticket with repro + failing log? i'll take it first thing after the deploy if it still happens.
carol: quick question — any objections to enabling prefix-KV cache for the canary? should cut cold-start tokens.
alex: go ahead and enable it for the canary. closely monitor cache hit-rate and mem-usage, revert if pressure spikes.
sam: added smoke test entry: ```curl -X POST https://ci.internal/smoke -d '{"model":"gpt-small-q","seq":1024}'``` scheduled at 00:50 UTC.
ci-bot: :white_check_mark: smoke test scheduled for 00:50 UTC — results will post here.
maya: leaving notes in the canary runbook and tagging the flakey test. will try a repro on a larger machine before we disable tests.
alex: thanks all. if rollback happens, i'll post a short incident template; otherwise i'll summarize results in tomorrow's async. :coffee:
